title: Adding the next frequency coordinate
statement: Let $U$ be a set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $k<n$. The elements of $U$ with index less than $k+1$ are obtained by adding coordinate $k$ to the elements with index less than $k$ if $k\in U$; if $k\notin U$, the set is unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $U$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
